title: Grateful Dead Live at Grand Prix Racecourse on 1973-07-28
source: Recording Info: SBD > Master Reels > .wav 24-bit/96k (Master Reels transferred by Rob Eaton); Mastering Info: .wav 24-bit/96k > Adobe Audition 3.0 24/96 > TLH > flac2496; 24-bit > 16-bit via dBpoweramp

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard remaster with superb instrument separation, highlighted by a scorching 'Playin'' jam and an unforgettable Good Lovin' stretch.
ai_review.review: This recording captures a top‑tier 1973 performance with immaculate audio fidelity—thanks to Scott Clugston’s remastering—and clear, well‑defined mix that lets every instrument shine. The band delivers a dazzling set, especially the funk‑laden Playin’ and an epic Good Lovin' jam, while Bill’s drumming drives the groove and Jerry’s improvisational twists keep the momentum alive.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviews are 5‑star, praising both the musical performance and the remastered soundboard quality; the consensus is overwhelmingly positive with no noted flaws.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Remaster praised for crystal‑clear fidelity, superb instrument separation, and successful pitch corrections; no reported dropouts or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert flows smoothly with a tight first set and an explosive second set, highlighted by the funk‑driven Playin' jam and a soaring Good Lovin' improvisation.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Noted for dynamic tempo shifts and high‑energy improvisation, pushing the band into faster or slower feels.
band_member_comments.Phil: Zip‑like bass riffs and melodic runs throughout, adding excitement to the jams.
band_member_comments.Bob: Delivers wicked funk picking early in the first jam, contributing a strong rhythmic drive.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill's drumming is described as laying down a solid, grooving foundation that fuels the performance.
